_meta.source: MOE Full SBB secondary school experience and FAQ; MOE S1 Posting pages; SEAB SEC page; MOE DSA for JC, Polytechnic EAE, ITE EAE and Post Secondary Admissions Exercise pages; MOE Education and Career Guidance page. Written for parents of the first SEC cohorts.
_meta.notes: Read from the primary MOE and SEAB pages, opened in full, on 2026-11-11. The four dated changes, the stream table and the windows were each checked against those pages. Early admissions months are the 2026 cycle; MOE had not published the 2027 dates. MOE states no date for choosing upper secondary subjects and no open house dates, so those two windows point to the school and the campus. One calm page. The parent is very often the person driving the subject combination decision, working from the system they went through, which no longer exists. Tone rules: never tells a parent they are wrong, never ranks routes, no dashes.

title: For parents
lede: The system your child is in is not the one you went through. Here is the shape of it, in five minutes.

sections.head: What changed since your day
sections.body: Express, Normal (Academic) and Normal (Technical) are gone. From the 2024 Sec 1 cohort your child takes each subject at its own level, G1, G2 or G3, and can mix them. The O and N Levels become one exam, the SEC, first sat in 2027, with all results in January. Mother Tongue has one written sitting, in September. From 2028 one Post Secondary Admissions Exercise replaces the JAE you remember, for JC, MI, polytechnic, PFP and ITE.

sections.head: What G1, G2 and G3 are
sections.body: Each is a level of one subject. G3 is the most demanding and G1 the least. They follow the old Express, Normal (Academic) and Normal (Technical) standards. A student can hold G3 English beside G2 Mathematics. Levels can move. MOE sets no dates for this: the school decides, on results in the subject and its view of the whole workload.

sections.head: When the decisions happen
sections.body: P6: the Posting Group, and six school choices in the 7 days after results. Sec 1 and 2: levels can move, and Humanities can move from Sec 2. Before Sec 3: the upper secondary subjects, on dates your school sets. Sec 4: Early Admissions before the exams, then one admissions exercise that opens on results day in January. A fifth year is open to students who meet MOE's criteria.

sections.head: Five conversations that help
items: Ask what they enjoy before you ask what they scored.
Go to one open house together, including one route you had not considered.
Ask the subject teacher what moving up a level would take.
Ask them to show you this tool and their three actions for the term.
Ask the ECG Counsellor at school. Guiding education and career plans is their job.

sections.head: Three that quietly hurt
items: Comparing with cousins and colleagues' children. Different child, different road.
Treating one route as the real one and the rest as fallbacks. The salary data does not support it and neither does the system.
Deciding for them. A route a child chose survives a hard year better than a route chosen for them.

sections.head: Where the official answers live
sections.body: moe.gov.sg for criteria, SchoolFinder for what each school runs, and your child's school for what is on offer, since schools run different subsets of subjects and lists change between cohorts. This tool is for thinking. Its school facts were read on MOE and SEAB pages on 11 November 2026, and anything not read from a primary page is marked provisional on screen.

windows.label: Upper secondary subjects
windows.when: During Sec 2, on your school's dates
windows.what: Your school guides the choice of upper secondary subjects. MOE sets no date for it. A level can still move later.

windows.label: Direct admission, DSA
windows.when: From May of Sec 4, for JC
windows.what: Talent based entry to a JC before the exams, on CCA records and a portfolio. Each JC sets its own dates, with offers into September.

windows.label: Early Admissions, EAE
windows.when: May for ITE, late June for polytechnic
windows.what: Polytechnic and ITE admission on aptitude and interest, before the exams. Polytechnic takes up to 3 courses. These are the 2026 months.
windows.check: Polytechnic EAE and ITE EAE pages

windows.label: Open houses
windows.what: JC, MI, polytechnic and ITE campuses hold open houses. MOE names these visits as part of ECG in secondary school.

windows.label: CCA record check
windows.what: CCA bonus points count in the admissions exercise. Ask your child to check the record with the school.
windows.check: MOE Post Secondary Admissions Exercise page

windows.label: The SEC papers
windows.what: English and Mother Tongue written papers in September, with one sitting only. Other papers follow from October. All results come in January.

windows.label: The main posting round
windows.what: One portal from 2028 for JC, MI, polytechnic, PFP and ITE. Six days to rank up to 12 courses. Posting results by early February.
windows.check: MOE Post Secondary Admissions Exercise page

guest.head: Play your own school years
guest.body: The game your child plays, but as you at fourteen: your old stream, translated into today's levels. Ten minutes, on this phone, and nothing your child saved here is read or touched.
guest.opens: That combination, in today's system, keeps {n} of the {total} destinations reachable.
guest.note: Opens as a guest. The game saves nothing to this phone, and handing it back leaves everything exactly as it was.

windowsHead: The windows, roughly when they open
windowsNote: Months drift from year to year, so every row needs checking against the named page. The knowledge is the order, and that none of these should arrive as a surprise.

changes.head: PSLE scored in Achievement Levels
changes.body: Each subject gets AL1 to AL8. The PSLE Score is their sum, from 4 to 32.

changes.head: Streams end
changes.body: From the 2024 Sec 1 cohort there are no Express or Normal streams. Each subject is taken at G1, G2 or G3.

changes.head: One exam, the SEC
changes.body: The Singapore Cambridge Secondary Education Certificate replaces the O and N Levels. Each subject is examined at its own level, and all results come in January.

changes.head: New admission rules
changes.body: JC counts five subjects. Polytechnic can count one subject at G2. One exercise, the PSE, covers JC, MI, polytechnic and ITE.

thenNow.head: Your stream, in today's words
thenNow.note: The change: your child takes each subject at its own level, and a level can move. The Posting Group only guides the starting levels.
